text:
maria: Seeing apiserver/watch reconnect spikes in eu-west1 since 04:12, lots of watch resets and etcd WAL fsync latency. GPU attach rate also jumped.

sam: Ugh. Any obvious trigger? deploys, config change? :eyes:

ajay: logs show controller-manager renewing leases very aggressively, hundreds/sec. Could be resync interval change.

leo: that was my canary — I reduced resync to 10s for stress tests yesterday to validate scale improvements. I didn't expect eu-west1 to hit the test fleet.

maria: snippets from apiserver and etcd around 04:12: 
```
I0319 04:12:03.123456 1 lease_controller.go:345] RenewLease pod/infra-gpu-123 duration=2.1ms
E0319 04:12:03.456789 1 apiserver.go:278] watch cache overflow: reconnections=1200/5m
etcd WAL fsync latency=1200ms iops=5
```

sam: ops-bot show recent scaling events?

ops-bot: autoscaler: GPU pool eu-west1 scale event at 04:11: +24 nodes (requested by gpu-autoscaler), reason: attach-rate spike

ajay: Cost impact looked nasty — +42% GPU usage hour-over-hour in that pool, probably will breach the reserved commit for acct-infra.

leo: propose rollback of the 10s resync to 30s and increase controller-manager lease-duration to 60s for now. That should reduce churn on etcd and watch fanout.

maria: agreed. I'll patch the canary to 30s and disable gpu-autoscaler scale-ups for eu-west1 until we stabilize. Doing patch now.

maria: kubectl patch command I used: 
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment controller-manager --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/","value":["--controllers=*,bootstrapsigner","--node-sync-period=30s","--lease-duration=60s","--leader-elect=true"]}]'
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/controller-manager in kube-system (canary)

sam: also let's add a short-term etcd compaction and bump the WAL sync threshold to reduce tail latencies (watch with caution). ajay can you run compaction?

ajay: running compaction now -> `etcdctl compact 20000 --endpoints=https://10.2.3.5:2379` then defrag.

ajay: defrag queued, will take ~40s for the leader region.

maria: after the patch metrics already look better — watch reconnects down from ~1200/5m to ~50/5m in the last 2m. WAL fsync p50 down to ~30ms.

ops-bot: metric: eu-west1 apiserver_watch_reconnects 04:10->04:18: 1200 -> 48

leo: nice. follow-ups: 1) revert resync config permanently from canary if no regressions, 2) add safeguard to not target stress-canaries at prod regions, 3) add controller-manager flag docs for limits.

sam: i'd also like a short runbook entry: if lease churn spikes, reduce resync and/or increase lease-duration, temporarily pause GPU autoscaling for affected pool.

ajay: noted — i'll add a short PR to runbook and link to this thread.

maria: thumbs. I'll keep the canary at 30s for 2 hours and then we can decide.

leo: thanks all. we'll follow up in the 1pm ops sync with numbers and cost delta.

sam: good catch — looks like small config change cascaded with autoscaler policy + GPU attach patterns. lesson: avoid low resync in prod regions unless behind a traffic-limited canary. :memo:
